{{Top|leg}}
A '''survival beacon''' was used to summon assistance by emitting a signal that could be detected by [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. They were generally employed by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]. The survivors of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] scout training mission that stumbled across a real [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base had to use a survival beacon to be rescued after the cadet leader, [[Talek Var]], used their [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] to destroy the Imperial base.
